terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} dong ebi yabo ka ube tiyo ku {method}.

• Ka podi etho ngo, juk {device} peri.
• Ka etiye ku USB, kwany woko.
{hint}

Dii OK mi caku man mi wok kud i Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Tip: Ka jam tic ne timo ngo kende kende, dii iwi button mi dwoko piny i pinhole ku paperclip podi i mako waya mi USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Tip: Keth jam tic peri i mode mi golo firmware (ma tung tung nimakere ku kit: e.g. kwany battery man iket woko ku USB cable, nyo juku mac ku battery i iye, nyo mako Volume Down/Up ka iketo USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Keth ku SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI dong ebi yabere ku firmware peri ma juyiko con.

• I SP Flash Tool, yier "Format All + Download" kud i sanduku ma piny.
• Di wi "Download" button.
• Bed ma ingeyo nia {device} peri uthum man uthum.
{hint}
• Med waya mi USB i kompyuta peri ingey dii iwi Download.

Dii OK mi caku SP Flash Tool man wok kud i Updater CE.

Kethu piny macon iwi jam tic eni bi juku caku tic.

donate_intro_success_mediatek:
Wa ketho {software} iwi {model} peri.

Hey! An a Ryan, jayub pa MediaTek Installer. Aculo pi gwoko piny man gwoko piny kud i cinga para ni gwoko installer eni ma epe man ma oyabere. Ka ekonyi, kwayu ipar pi miyo kony — eketho yub ne bedo makwo pi dhanu ceke.
donate_intro_general_mediatek: Nenedi! An a Ryan, jayub pa MediaTek Installer. Aculo pi gwoko piny, jam tic man ka gwoko piny kud i cinga gira kara installer eni obed agonya. Gwoko dwe ku dwe romo $200 — kony moko ci ma imiyo konyo ni gwoko kwo pa jumatiyo mukende.
donate_intro_success:
Wa ketho {software} iwi {model} peri.

Hey! An a Ryan, jayub pa Updater CE, Community Firmware Archive, man Themes Gallery. Aculo ~$200 dwe ku dwe pa server man ka gwoko piny kud i cinga pi gwoko piny ceke ma tiye agonya man ma oyabere. Ka jam tic eni ukonyu, kepar pi miyo kony — eketho piny eni bedo kwo ni dhanu ceke.
donate_intro_general: Nenedi! An a Ryan, jayub pa Updater CE, Community Firmware Archive, man Themes Gallery. Aculu pi gwoko server, gwoko firmware, man dwoko domain manyen kud i cinga gira kara piny ceke ubed m'umbe cul. Gwoko dwe ku dwe romo $200 — kony moko ci ma imiyo konyo ni gwoko jam tic eni makwo pi won piny mukende.

themepack_step1_title: Thenge mir acel: Med i USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Yab player peri ku mako button mi Power.
2. Ka Rockbox ucaku tic, med waya mi USB i kompyuta peri.
3. Ka jupenje iwi jamb tugu, keth USB Storage mode wek jam tic ne onen calu drive.
themepack_step2_title: Thenge mir 2: Yier Folder moko ci iwi Player
themepack_step2_desc: Pien operating systems (macalu macOS) kano dotfiles (macalu .rockbox) ku default, icopo yero ANY folder nyo drive root iwi player peri. Wabiro nwangu nyo cwio .rockbox directory piri.
themepack_complete: Theme pack juyike maber! Dong icopo ketho jamb tiyo peri maber man iyer theme in Rockbox (Kabedo > Theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: Icopo nwangu ngo nyo caku .rockbox directory iwi drive ma juyeru. Kwayu nen nia iyero folda moko iwi player peri.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Thenge mir acel: Cak tuko kendu man idok kendu
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Gony waya pa USB.
2. Med kero pa jatug ne man iwek edok i Rockbox.
3. Ka Rockbox ucaku tic, dwoko waya pa USB, man i dii Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Thenge mir 2: Sayu jatug iwi ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App ne ube neno pi rwate pa ADB (ma romo ceken 30). Ka junwango jam tic moko, theme jubi loko man player bi caku kendu kende. Ka epe, cidhi i USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Jam tic ma junwango ({serial}); loko wi lembe...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Jam ADB moko ope ma junwango ikind sekond 30; mediri ku USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: ADB binary ope ma nwangre i app; mediri ku USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Kethu wi lembe man coc iwi ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB transfer upoto; dwoko cen i USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Keth USB Storage Mode iwi player kara ebed calu drive.
2. Ngi folda moku ci iwi jam tuko piny eno (.rockbox, wer, the lembe, nyo drive root — folda .rockbox ma ungire kende kende).
3. App ne diyo 360p themes man fonts i iye, man kyewo wi file ma nying gi rom.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Icopo ketho jam tugu maber man i yero theme in Rockbox (Kabedo > Theme Settings).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Version macon pa Updater podi utiye iwi kompyuta eni man etingo kabedo i disk. Ka juwodho woko, weko kabedo meno bedo agonya.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Woth Innioasis Updater macon man kabedo mi kony
